name: ordered-list-restart-after-note-project-checklist
description: An ordered list is interrupted by a normal paragraph and then resumes as a restarted numbered list, which can be mistaken for continuous numbering in Markdown conversion.

runs.text: Confirm access with the building manager.
Print two copies of the inspection checklist.
Note: The first two steps are handled by the office coordinator before the field team leaves.
Pack a flashlight, tape measure, and spare batteries.
Photograph any visible water damage on arrival.
